intervention_classes.name: Cost-base diagnostic
evidence_prerequisites: persistent supported cost or efficiency evidence
limitations: does not establish which costs should change
cannot infer causation from margin alone

intervention_classes.name: Productivity improvement
evidence_prerequisites: input-output evidence or repeated supported deterioration
limitations: automation investment alone is insufficient
workforce effects require context

intervention_classes.name: Capacity utilisation review
limitations: does not recommend closure or expansion
seasonality may explain utilisation

intervention_classes.name: Footprint optimisation
limitations: cannot prescribe closing a specific site
transition risk and labour impacts need private evidence

intervention_classes.name: Supply-chain resilience review
evidence_prerequisites: supplier or flow context where public
limitations: public disclosure rarely identifies full supplier topology

intervention_classes.name: Working-capital improvement
limitations: inventory build may be deliberate resilience
linkage is not causation

intervention_classes.name: Organisation simplification
limitations: does not justify role reductions
culture and capability require primary research

intervention_classes.name: Leadership/execution review
evidence_prerequisites: repeated execution evidence or relevant leadership discontinuity
limitations: not a management-quality score
planned succession is not failure

intervention_classes.name: Technology-delivery recovery
limitations: programme launch alone is insufficient
public evidence may omit root cause

intervention_classes.name: Investment-productivity review
evidence_prerequisites: investment amount timing and intended outcome
limitations: long lags may be appropriate
cannot infer project NPV from public signals

intervention_classes.name: Make/buy analysis
limitations: requires confidential unit economics and risk data

intervention_classes.name: Complexity reduction
limitations: complexity is not directly observable from most public disclosures
product or customer actions require granular evidence
